problem: Powerhouse had strong Company Intelligence, autonomous-improvement, quality and engineering-learning capabilities, but lacked one explicit cross-layer contract joining agent objectives, model routing, architecture health, evaluation/promotion and learning compilation into a single compounding intelligence loop.
root_cause: Capabilities existed across separate canonical subsystems without one explicit self-improvement authority and measurable north-star contract.
decision: Add a thin Self-Improvement Layer that composes existing authorities rather than creating parallel stores or schedulers.
prevention: Every agent must expose a measurable objective plus guardrails.
Every material candidate must pass evidence, quality, security and regression gates.
Architecture health participates in promotion decisions.
Learning compiles into regression, skill, documentation, system-map and bounded candidate outputs.
No learning path may directly rewrite production.
